analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see maintained. RSI entered oversold territory, ADX trend is weak. Current price 28,470 KRW, approaching swing support at 28,350 KRW. Volume ratio to 5-day average is 0.46, indicating contraction. With ATR of 1,849 KRW, setting stop loss at 1.0-4.0x ATR implies stop prices between 26,621-24,621 KRW for an entry at 28,470 KRW, and target prices between 30,319-32,169 KRW. Risk/reward ratio of 1.5 or higher is met.
